title: Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease Rate Card: Lease Rates, Depreciation, Management Fees and Terms
content:
# Rate Card — Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease

This rate card gives, for each program tier of the Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease, the rental pricing figures written onto a unit schedule and the term and equipment limits that go with them.

## Lease rate, management fee and term limits by tier

The lease rate is the annual rate applied to book value to compute the monthly lease charge. The management fee is a per-unit monthly fee added to each rental. The minimum term is the months a TRAC unit must stay in service before it may be terminated without the minimum-term charge.

| Program tier | Annual lease rate | Monthly management fee per unit (USD) | Minimum term, TRAC units (months) | Longest scheduled term (months) | Lowest TRAC residual, percent of capitalized cost | Maximum upfit cost, percent of chassis capitalized cost |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Business Advantage | 8.25 percent | 45 | 12 | 48 | 15 | 15 |
| Kestrel Fleet Select | 7.75 percent | 40 | 12 | 60 | 15 | 20 |
| Kestrel Fleet Preferred | 7.25 percent | 35 | 12 | 60 | 15 | 25 |
| Kestrel Fleet Premier | 6.9 percent | 30 | 12 | 60 | 15 | 30 |
| Kestrel Fleet Enterprise | 6.6 percent | 25 | 12 | 72 | 15 | 35 |
| Kestrel National Fleet | 6.35 percent | 20 | 12 | 72 | 15 | 40 |

The TRAC residual is the unit's book value at the scheduled end of its term.

## Monthly depreciation by vehicle class (TRAC units)

Monthly depreciation is stated as a percent of capitalized cost and is the same in every program tier.

| Vehicle class | Monthly depreciation, percent of capitalized cost |
|---|---|
| Light-duty pickup | 2.0 |
| Cargo van | 2.0 |
| Passenger van | 2.25 |
| SUV | 2.0 |
| Sedan | 2.5 |
| Medium-duty chassis | 1.75 |

## First rental

In every program tier the first rental after acceptance is prorated from the acceptance date.

## Notes on the card

- The minimum term (12 months) and the lowest TRAC residual (15 percent) do not vary by tier; the lease rate, the management fee, the longest term and the upfit limit do.
- **Hypothetical illustration.** A cargo van with a hypothetical capitalized cost of 40000 depreciates 2.0 percent of that cost a month, 800, in whichever tier its schedule was written; a sedan of the same hypothetical cost depreciates 2.5 percent, 1000.
